5800.name: A Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Mist.

east.description: To the east lies The Incomplete Pentagram.

west.description: To the west lies The Red Dragon's Lair.

5800.description:
The tunnel is wrong in a way you cannot name, its walls of sweating
black stone bending where they should run straight. A thin mist curls in
from the passage north, and a heavy door stands in the east wall,
scratched with crooked lines. To the west the floor is scorched and the
air carries the smell of burnt flesh from the lair beyond. Somewhere in
the dark, soft voices say your name and then fall silent.

5801.name: The Mist

south.description: To the south lies A Strange Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Mist.

north.description: To the north lies The Mist.

5801.description:
Grey-black mist fills every pace of space here, so thick that your hand
fades at the wrist. The floor underfoot is smooth stone, damp and
faintly warm, and you cannot tell which way it slopes. Whispers drift
past from all sides, each promising a way out, and every promise leads
back to the same cold nothing. There is no wall, no passage, only the
mist closing round you.

5802.name: The Mist

west.description: To the west lies The Mist.

north.description: To the north lies The Mist.

5802.description:
The mist here is tinged faintly green and tastes of old iron and
standing water. Pillars of dark stone loom at the edge of sight and
vanish when you look straight at them. Footsteps that are not your own
pace beside you in the murk, always just out of reach. Whichever way you
turn, the fog shows nothing but more fog.

5803.name: The Mist

south.description: To the south lies The Mist.

5803.description:
Here the mist hangs low and heavy, pooling about your knees like cold
milk, while above it the air is clear and black. Any light you carry
shrinks to a smear. A faint voice, sweet and sorrowful, calls from
somewhere close and then, a heartbeat later, from very far away. The
floor is bare rock slick with condensation.

5804.name: The Mist

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Mist.

5804.description:
Pale threads of mist twist about one another here like rope, and the
stone underfoot is cracked and gritty. The passage you came by lies
behind you, though in this murk it is hard to believe it was ever real.
Whispers pool at your ears, urging you to step forward into nothing.
Every sound is muffled flat, as if the fog had swallowed the world.

5805.name: The Dark Passage

north.description: To the north lies A Stone Maze.

south.description: To the south lies The Mist.

5805.description:
A narrow passage of black granite runs straight and smooth, its roof low
enough to brush with a raised hand. The mist thins here and you can see
a few paces before the dark takes over. A door of iron-banded black wood
bars the way north into a stone maze, while behind you to the south the
grey fog rolls thick. The air smells of cold ash.

5806.name: A Stone Maze

north.description: To the north lies A Long Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies A Dead-End Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Passage.

west.description: To the west lies The Ancient Troglodyte Passage.

5806.description:
Corridors of fitted stone cross and recross at this junction, and the
walls bear scratches left by travellers who tried to count their turns.
A long corridor leads north, a dead-end room lies east, the dark passage
runs south, and a door west opens on ancient troglodyte workings. The
air moves in slow breaths, as though something large were asleep nearby.
A whisper from the walls insists that the way you want is the one you
just refused.

5807.name: A Dead-End Room

west.description: To the west lies A Stone Maze.

5807.description:
A small bare room of black stone with no door but the one you came in
by. The floor is scored with the scratches of fingernails where someone
tried to dig out. Mist gathers in the corners, like damp that has
nowhere to go. The only way out is west, back to the stone maze.

5808.name: A Long Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Maze Turning Point.

south.description: To the south lies A Stone Maze.

5808.description:
The corridor stretches long and perfectly straight, its black walls
close enough to touch on both sides. Water beads on the stone and runs
in thin tracks to a gutter along the floor. Your footsteps return a
half-beat late, as if someone behind you were stepping in time. The
corridor runs north toward a turning and south back toward the junction
of the maze.

5810.name: The Maze Turning Point

north.description: To the north lies A Deadly Passage.

east.description: To the east lies A Quick Turn In The Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Long Corridor.

5810.description:
The corridor splits at a worn flagstone where countless boots have
turned left and right. A narrow passage that looks deadly runs north, a
quick turn bends away east, and the long corridor lies behind you to the
south. Chalk marks on the walls have been scrubbed out and rewritten so
often that they now say nothing at all. The mist is thin here, but the
whispers are loud.

5811.name: A Deadly Passage

south.description: To the south lies The Maze Turning Point.

5811.description:
This passage ends in a blind wall, and it earns its name from the floor,
where pale bones lie drifted against the stone. Narrow slits in the
walls hint at dart traps long since spent, and the flags are pitted
where something acid has eaten them. The air is dry and tastes of rust.
The only way back is south, to the turning of the maze.

5813.name: A Quick Turn In The Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Dead Pool.

west.description: To the west lies The Maze Turning Point.

5813.description:
The corridor bends so sharply here that a running man would crash into
the wall. The black stone of the corner is polished by hands that have
caught themselves on it. A cold damp breeze flows from the passage
north, carrying the smell of stagnant water. To the west the corridor
returns to the maze turning.

5814.name: The Dead Pool

north.description: To the north lies The Dead Pool.

south.description: To the south lies A Quick Turn In The Corridor.

5814.description:
A still pool of black water fills most of the chamber, its surface so
flat and lifeless that it reflects nothing. A narrow ledge of wet stone
skirts the water, and you edge along it with your back to the wall. No
ripple, no insect, no pale fish disturbs the pool. The chamber goes on
north along the ledge, and south is the corridor you came by.

5815.name: The Dead Pool

south.description: To the south lies The Dead Pool.

west.description: To the west lies The Downward Spiral.

5815.description:
The dead pool deepens here into a round well of ink-dark water that laps
softly at the base of the walls. The air hangs sour and motionless, and
a slick grey film clings to the edge. A curving stair of black stone
leads west to a spiral that goes down. Something far below the surface
seems to look back up at you.

5816.name: The Downward Spiral

east.description: To the east lies The Dead Pool.

down.description: To the down lies The Mud Pit.

5816.description:
A stair of black granite coils downward into the dark, each tread worn
to a shallow dish by ages of descending feet. The central pillar is
carved with spirals that seem to turn if you stare at them. Mud and damp
cling to the lower steps, and the whispers grow muffled as you descend.
To the east the dead pool glimmers, and the spiral winds on down toward
a mud pit.

5817.name: The Ancient Troglodyte Passage

east.description: To the east lies A Stone Maze.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn In The Troglodyte Passage.

5817.description:
The worked stone gives way to rough-hewn rock, cut long ago by
troglodytes with tools of bone and flint. The walls are sooty and marked
with crude pictures of hunters and long-necked beasts. A rank, reptilian
stink hangs in the passage. East the way leads back through a door to
the maze, and west it bends deeper into the old workings.

5818.name: A Turn In The Troglodyte Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Ancient Troglodyte Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Ancient Troglodyte Passage.

5818.description:
The passage elbows sharply here, the rock floor scored with the dragging
marks of heavy tails. Fungus glows a faint sickly yellow in a seam of
the wall, giving just enough light to see your hands. A colder draught
flows from the north, where the passage opens wider, and the way east
returns by the route you came.

5819.name: The Ancient Troglodyte Hall

north.description: To the north lies A Dead-End In The Troglodyte Passage.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn In The Troglodyte Passage.

5819.description:
A long hall hacked from the living rock, its low roof held up by squat
stone columns carved with spirals and teeth. Stone benches run along the
walls, worn into hollows by generations of scaled backsides. Ashes lie
cold in a central fire pit, and the soot above is black as pitch. The
hall continues north to a dead end, and south it narrows to the bend in
the passage.

5820.name: A Dead-End In The Troglodyte Passage

east.description: To the east lies The Troglodyte Guard Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Ancient Troglodyte Hall.

5820.description:
The passage ends in a blank wall of grey, sweating rock, and a heavy
door of slab stone is set in the side wall to the east. Claw-scratches
mark the lower edge of the door where something once tried to get out,
or in. The air is stale and tastes of lizard and smoke. Southward the
passage goes back to the hall.

5821.name: The Troglodyte Guard Room

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Troglodyte's Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead-End In The Troglodyte Passage.

5821.description:
A cramped guard room whose floor is littered with sleeping-pallets of
reeds long since rotted to mulch. Racks of knotted bone line the walls,
empty now but for dust. A stone door south leads on to the royal
chamber, and the passage west returns to the dead end.

5822.name: The Royal Troglodyte's Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Troglodyte Guard Room.

5822.description:
The royal chamber is the best room the troglodytes ever cut, a rounded
vault with a dais of piled stone at the far end. Ochre handprints climb
the walls like a ladder of years. Cold braziers of beaten bronze stand
at the corners, green with age. The only way out is north, through the
stone door to the guard room.

5823.name: The Mud Pit

north.description: To the north lies The Damp Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Webbed Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Mud Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Downward Spiral.

5823.description:
The floor falls away into a wide pit of thick grey-brown mud that sucks
at every footstep. Water dripping from the roof of black rock keeps it
forever soft, and the stench of rot rises from the churned surface.
Three ways lead out of the muck: a damp corridor north, a webbed passage
through a door east, and a sloping mud tunnel south. Slick handholds in
the rock show where others have dragged themselves clear.

5824.name: The Webbed Passage

east.description: To the east lies The Crab Spider's Den.

west.description: To the west lies The Mud Pit.

5824.description:
Grey sheets of web span the passage from floor to ceiling, thick as
sailcloth and clotted with the husks of things that tried to pass.
Strands tug at your sleeves as you push through. The webbing is thickest
toward the east, where the passage opens into a den, while the mud pit
lies behind you to the west. A dry chittering runs along the silk
threads like a message.

5825.name: The Crab Spider's Den

north.description: To the north lies The Crab Spider's Inner Den.

west.description: To the west lies The Webbed Passage.

5825.description:
A wide den hung with silk, its floor padded with old webbing and
littered with crushed shells and the cleaned legs of larger prey. Pale
egg sacs hang in clusters from the roof, swaying a little though the air
is still. The den narrows to the north, and the webbed passage lies back
to the west. Every surface is faintly sticky.

5826.name: The Crab Spider's Inner Den

south.description: To the south lies The Crab Spider's Den.

west.description: To the west lies The King Crab Spider's Den.

5826.description:
The silk thickens into a dense grey tapestry that muffles every sound,
and the roof sags under drapes of web. The floor is deep with crumbled
husks that crunch and give underfoot. A dank sweetness hangs in the air.
The den opens south to the outer den, and west the web-hung way runs on
toward a larger lair.

5827.name: The King Crab Spider's Den

east.description: To the east lies The Crab Spider's Inner Den.

5827.description:
This is the last and greatest den, a high vault wound about with web as
thick as ship's cable. Enormous claw-marks gouge the rock where
something far bigger than any ordinary spider has dragged its bulk. The
bones of men hang in the silk like washing on a line. The only way out
is east, back through the inner den.

5828.name: The Mud Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Mud Pit.

south.description: To the south lies The Mud Slide.

5828.description:
The tunnel is a trough of churned mud that sucks at your boots and soaks
you to the knee. The roof drips steadily and the walls glisten with grey
slime. Wooden props, rotten and sagging, shore the worst of the ceiling.
The tunnel runs north to the mud pit and slopes away south toward a
slide.

5829.name: The Mud Slide

north.description: To the north lies The Mud Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5829.description:
The floor tilts steeply here into a slick chute of black mud, polished
smooth by those who slid down it and never climbed back. Scrapes of
fingers run along the rock above. Cold air rises from the drop, smelling
of wet stone and endless depth. The tunnel climbs back north, and the
chute plunges down into the dark.

5830.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

south.description: To the south lies Deep Into The Mist.

up.description: To the up lies The Mud Slide.

east.description: To the east lies Deep Into The Mist.

5830.description:
Enormous black pillars rise from the floor and vanish in the mist
overhead, each wider than a cart and carved with scenes you would rather
not read. Beyond them the floor ends, and below is a drop with no bottom
that you can see. A cold wind rises from the void, bringing the murmur
of voices long dead. The mud of the chute still clings to your boots.

extra_descs.pillars carvings scenes:
The carvings wind round each pillar in bands: a procession of figures
led down into a pit, a feast of shadows, a door. The last band has been
chiselled away.

5831.name: The Damp Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To The Minotaur's Lair.

south.description: To the south lies The Mud Pit.

5831.description:
Water seeps down the walls of this corridor in long glistening streaks,
and the floor is a skin of slippery clay. Pale, sightless moss clings in
clumps to the ceiling. The corridor climbs gently north toward the
entrance of a lair, and from there comes a smell of musk and old blood.
To the south it falls back to the mud pit.

5832.name: The Entrance To The Minotaur's Lair

east.description: To the east lies The Minotaur's Stairway.

south.description: To the south lies The Damp Corridor.

5832.description:
A doorless arch twice the height of a man marks the entrance to the
lair, its jambs scored with deep gouges at horn height. Bleached bones
of cattle and men are heaped in the corners, picked clean. The passage
turns east to a broad stair going down, while to the south the damp
corridor retreats. A heavy animal smell rolls up the stair, and far
below something huffs and shifts.

5833.name: The Minotaur's Stairway

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance To The Minotaur's Lair.

down.description: To the down lies The Bottom Of The Minotaur's Stairway.

5833.description:
Broad stairs of rough black stone descend steeply, each step chipped and
gouged by hooves. A torch bracket on the wall holds nothing but a clot
of old tallow. At the top of the stair the way leads west toward the
lair entrance, and below it drops into a thick, warm darkness. The smell
down there is strong enough to taste.

5834.name: The Bottom Of The Minotaur's Stairway

north.description: To the north lies The Minotaur's Lair.

up.description: To the up lies The Minotaur's Stairway.

5834.description:
The stairs end on a trampled floor of packed earth and straw gone black
with filth. Great hoofprints are pressed into the dirt, and a rusted
chain is anchored to the wall for some unlucky captive. The ground
slopes north into the lair proper, while the stair climbs back up behind
you. The air is hot, as if from a living furnace.

5835.name: The Minotaur's Lair

north.description: To the north lies The Minor Minotaur's Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Bottom Of The Minotaur's Stairway.

5835.description:
A broad hall opens here, its roof lost in shadow and its floor strewn
with dung-black straw. A crude stone trough runs along one wall, fouled
with something long dead. Horn marks scar the pillars of rock at every
height. Passages lead north to a smaller chamber and south to the foot
of the stair.

5836.name: The Minor Minotaur's Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Major Minotaur's Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Minotaur's Lair.

5836.description:
A squat chamber with a low roof, furnished with a heap of hides and a
gnawed wooden bench that once served some man. The walls are raw stone
daubed with red hand-prints, many of them small. A door of splintered
planks leads south to the lair, and an archway north opens on a grander
room. The floor is trampled bare.

5837.name: The Major Minotaur's Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Black Granite Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Minor Minotaur's Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies Back Into The Mist.

5837.description:
A tall chamber of black granite, its walls hung with ragged banners
whose emblems have rotted to colourless smears. A great slab of stone
serves as a table, scarred with cleaver blows and stained dark. Doors of
iron-bound oak stand to the south and the north, both pitted by horns.
The roof is lost to shadow, and a low rumbling echoes down from
somewhere.

5838.name: The Black Granite Room

north.description: To the north lies The Great Minotaur's Inner Sanctum.

east.description: To the east lies The Room With No Ceiling.

south.description: To the south lies The Major Minotaur's Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Turning Corridor.

5838.description:
Black granite, polished to the shine of a mirror, forms floor, wall and
ceiling here, so that your own pale face stares back from every side.
Four ways lead off: a stout door north, an open passage east, the door
south to the major chamber, and a turning corridor west. The whispers
are loudest in this room, and they seem to come from the stone itself.
Your reflected figures move a moment after you do.

extra_descs.granite mirror reflection:
The polished stone shows you black and white and faintly grey. Behind
your reflection something else seems to stand, and is gone when you
turn.

5839.name: The Great Minotaur's Inner Sanctum

south.description: To the south lies The Black Granite Room.

5839.description:
The sanctum is a vault of black stone lit by a sullen red glow from
braziers that have burned for years without fuel. Heaps of rubble, bone
and broken blades are piled against the walls, the hoard of a beast that
mistook cruelty for kingship. A huge throne of horned skulls dominates
the far end. The only way out is the door south to the black granite
room.

5840.name: The Turning Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Black Granite Room.

south.description: To the south lies Back Into The Mist.

5840.description:
The corridor turns and turns again, its walls slightly out of true so
that your sense of direction slips away. The black stone is cold and
faintly oily to the touch. To the east lies the polished black granite
room, and to the south the way slides into a bank of mist. A whisper at
your elbow suggests, kindly, that you stop walking.

5841.name: Back Into The Mist

north.description: To the north lies The Turning Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies Back Into The Mist.

5841.description:
The corridor's stone dissolves into mist and you are among the grey
again, with no wall to keep a hand on. The fog beads on your cloak and
eyelashes and tastes of cold metal. Faint murmurs promise that you are
nearly back to somewhere you know. You begin to suspect there is a floor
beneath you and nothing else at all.

5842.name: Back Into The Mist

north.description: To the north lies Back Into The Mist.

5842.description:
The mist presses close again, and this time it carries a faint stink of
brimstone. Pillars loom and fade at the edge of sight, always at the
same distance however far you walk. The ground beneath is smooth black
stone slick with dew. The whispers are all behind you now, and none will
say where they have gone.

5843.name: Back Into The Mist

north.description: To the north lies Back Into The Mist.

5843.description:
You walk on into the mist and find the walls have vanished, replaced by
a dim grey emptiness. Your breath comes back to you in a warm cloud, and
a cold hand seems to rest briefly on your shoulder. Lost voices argue in
low tones just out of hearing. The floor is bare rock, patched with
small pools of fog-water.

5844.name: Back Into The Mist

east.description: To the east lies The Major Minotaur's Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Back Into The Mist.

5844.description:
Here the mist is so dense that it seems to have weight, pressing on your
chest and ears like deep water. A sweet, rotten smell comes and goes.
Corpse-lights drift at the edge of vision, pale and slow, and are gone
before you can name them. Beneath your boots the floor is gritty with
black sand.

5845.name: Deep Into The Mist

north.description: To the north lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

east.description: To the east lies The Mist.

south.description: To the south lies A Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5845.description:
You are deep in the mist now, and four ways offer themselves, none of
them certain. One slopes toward a gleam of pillars north, another toward
a denser fog east, a third toward a tunnel south, and a fourth, west,
bends the same way as the first. The fog is the colour of old pewter and
moves as though breathing. Whispers beckon from every quarter, each
insisting that it alone knows the road.

5846.name: The Room With No Ceiling

west.description: To the west lies The Black Granite Room.

down.description: To the down lies Under The Well.

5846.description:
Above you there is no ceiling at all, only a shaft of blackness rising
out of sight, with thin mist drifting slowly down it. The walls are
smooth black stone running up into the dark. In the middle of the floor
an old stone well-head gapes, its rim worn by rope, and rusted iron
rungs lead down inside. A passage runs west to the black granite room.

extra_descs.well rungs:
The well is a plain ring of old stone, wide enough for one body. Iron
rungs, orange with rust, are set into its wall and vanish down into the
dark.

5847.name: The Mist
5847.description:
The mist is thinner here and tinted a bruised violet, so that the black
stone of the floor shows in patches like islands. There is a smell of
crushed herbs, wrong in this place. A voice in the fog hums an old
lullaby, off-key, and breaks off each time you listen. You are cut off,
with only the fog for company.

5848.name: The Mist

east.description: To the east lies A Small Passage.

5848.description:
Grey fog drifts in slow whorls about a doorway of black stone set in the
nearby wall. The door leads east into a narrow passage, its iron hinges
beaded with damp. The floor beneath is polished granite, treacherous
with condensation. The whispers circle you as if curious whether you
will go through.

5849.name: A Small Passage

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies The Mist.

5849.description:
A small passage, no wider than your shoulders, runs between smooth black
walls polished by ages of fog. The roof is low and the floor slopes
almost unnoticed. A little way east a pale light shows where the passage
opens into a dark clearing. The door to the mist lies west behind you,
hanging open on its hinges.

5850.name: The Mist
5850.description:
Mist, patient and thick, shot through with faint motes of light like the
sparks of a dying fire. The floor is cold wet rock, and the sound of
dripping fills the air from no direction. The whispers offer you things:
a name, a home, a road. All of them end in the same grey nothing.

5851.name: The Mist

down.description: To the down lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5851.description:
The mist thins at one spot to reveal an edge, beyond which a long stair
of black stone spirals down toward the pillars. Cold damp air presses up
from below. The whispers urge you to step off the edge instead of using
the stair. Fog clings to the lip in ragged flags.

5852.name: A Dark Clearing

east.description: To the east lies The Circular Hall.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Passage.

5852.description:
The passage widens into a dark clearing, a broad floor of black granite
with no wall within reach and a ceiling lost in gloom. Stunted pale
fungus grows in clumps like a garden gone wrong. East lies a round hall
beneath a faint glow, and west the narrow passage squeezes back toward
the mist.

5854.name: The Circular Hall

south.description: To the south lies A Black Granite Stairwell.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Clearing.

5854.description:
A great circular hall whose floor is inlaid in black and grey granite in
rings that spiral to the centre. A ring of carved pillars holds up a
domed ceiling lost in murk. The echoes here are false and arrive from
the wrong side. A stairwell of black granite opens to the south, and the
clearing lies back to the west.

5855.name: A Black Granite Stairwell

north.description: To the north lies The Circular Hall.

up.description: To the up lies The Entrance To The Black Granite Labyrinth.

5855.description:
A narrow stairwell of black granite winds upward in tight turns, the
steps polished and the rail cold. A dim luminescence seeps from the
joints between the stones. The air grows drier and the whispers sharper
as the stair climbs. A passage leads north back to the circular hall,
and the stair rises toward the entrance of the labyrinth.

5856.name: The Entrance To The Black Granite Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

west.description: To the west lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

down.description: To the down lies A Black Granite Stairwell.

5856.description:
The stair comes out in a hall of black granite where two corridors lead
away, each as dark and polished as the last. Scratches in the floor show
where earlier travellers tried to leave a trail, and were turned about.
One passage runs north, another west, and the stair drops down to the
stairwell. The air is dry as a tomb's.

5857.name: The Black Granite Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies A Black, Circular Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance To The Black Granite Labyrinth.

5857.description:
The labyrinth's walls are blocks of black granite fitted so tightly that
no blade could slide between them. The floor is faintly tilted, and the
corridor shows an identical stretch both ahead and behind. A single drop
of water falls somewhere with a slow, regular tap. North lies a round
room, and south, the entrance.

5858.name: A Black, Circular Room

south.description: To the south lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

west.description: To the west lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

down.description: To the down lies A Dusty Corridor.

5858.description:
A perfectly circular room of black granite, its floor inlaid with a ring
of pale dust that your steps never seem to disturb. The ceiling bows
overhead like the inside of an egg. Two passages open, one south and one
west, while a square hole in the floor shows a dusty corridor below,
reached by worn handholds.

extra_descs.dust ring floor:
The ring of dust lies in a shallow groove. However hard you scuff it, it
lies exactly as it did, fine and grey and undisturbed.

5859.name: The Black Granite Labyrinth

east.description: To the east lies A Black, Circular Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Black, Square Room.

5859.description:
A twisting corridor of black granite, scored along the lower walls with
gouges as if by giant claws. The air is stuffy and the dark so total
that the walls seem to lean in. A pale draught flows from the west,
where a square chamber waits, and to the east the corridor returns to
the round room.

5860.name: A Black, Square Room

east.description: To the east lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

south.description: To the south lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

down.description: To the down lies The Skeleton Cathedral.

5860.description:
A perfect square of black granite, each wall equal and each corner
sharp, with a floor of squares like a chessboard of shadow. In the
centre a round opening yawns, rimmed by worn steps that lead down into a
great cold space. A corridor runs east and another south. A faint
chanting of bone and wind rises from below.

5861.name: The Black Granite Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies A Black, Square Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Black, Triangular Room.

5861.description:
The corridor narrows until you must turn your shoulders, black stone
pressing on either side. Dust lies thick and undisturbed on the floor,
then in places is wiped clean in patterns that suggest dancing. The way
runs north to a square room and south to a triangular one. A slow
dripping counts out a rhythm just beyond understanding.

5862.name: A Black, Triangular Room

north.description: To the north lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

east.description: To the east lies The Black Granite Labyrinth.

down.description: To the down lies A Dirt Room.

5862.description:
A triangular room, its three walls of black granite meeting in corners
that seem sharper than corners should be. A rough hole has been broken
through the floor, its edges chipped, leading down into raw earth.
Passages leave to the north and the east. The air smells of damp soil
and old stone.

5863.name: The Black Granite Labyrinth

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance To The Black Granite Labyrinth.

west.description: To the west lies A Black, Triangular Room.

5863.description:
The corridor here is half choked with a drift of black grit, as though
the walls were crumbling. Where the dust is thin you can see the tool-
marks of the long-dead builders. Eastward the way returns to the
entrance of the labyrinth, while to the west lies a triangular room.
Your breath hangs in the air though no cold can be felt.

5864.name: A Dirt Room

up.description: To the up lies A Black, Triangular Room.

down.description: To the down lies A Small Burrow.

5864.description:
The granite gives way to raw dirt here, a low chamber of packed earth
with roots hanging from the ceiling like pale fingers. Burrowing marks
run in spirals through the walls. A ragged hole above leads back up to
the triangular room, and a smaller tunnel slopes down. The air is damp,
earthy and close.

5865.name: A Small Burrow

up.description: To the up lies A Dirt Room.

5865.description:
A cramped burrow, round in section and scarcely tall enough to kneel in.
The earth walls are slick and smoothed by the passage of a long body,
and a nest of matted hair and old bones fills one end. It is a dead end,
and the only exit is the hole leading up to the dirt room.

5866.name: The Skeleton Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies The End Of The Skeleton Cathedral.

up.description: To the up lies A Black, Square Room.

5866.description:
A vast vaulted hall whose columns, arches and ribs are built entirely of
bones, stacked and mortared with black clay into soaring shapes. Rows of
skulls stare from every niche. The vault hums faintly, as though the
bones remembered hymns. A stair of skulls climbs to the square room
above, and the nave stretches away north.

extra_descs.skulls niches bones:
Hundreds of skulls sit in the niches, each facing the nave. Some of the
jaws hang open, and from them comes the faint hum that fills the vault.

5867.name: The End Of The Skeleton Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies The End Of The Skeleton Cathedral.

east.description: To the east lies Below The Lair Of The Deadly Black Dragon.

south.description: To the south lies The Skeleton Cathedral.

west.description: To the west lies A Room Made Of Bones.

5867.description:
The nave ends at an altar-step of fused vertebrae, and behind it a great
window of translucent skull-plates glows a dim amber. The chancel loops
oddly back on itself, so that walking north seems to leave you exactly
where you began. Doors of rib and sinew-cord stand to the east and west,
and the nave runs back south. The floor is paved with knuckles that
click underfoot like dice.

5868.name: A Room Made Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies The End Of The Skeleton Cathedral.

5868.description:
Every surface of this room is bone: walls of stacked thighbones, a floor
of crushed ribs, a ceiling hung with a lattice of spines. Skulls with
candle stubs wedged in their eye-sockets give a sour, flickering light.
The air is dry and sweet with the smell of old marrow. The only way out
is the door east to the cathedral.

5869.name: Below The Lair Of The Deadly Black Dragon

west.description: To the west lies The End Of The Skeleton Cathedral.

up.description: To the up lies The Lair Of The Deadly Black Dragon.

5869.description:
A low antechamber of scorched black rock, its floor coated in fine soot
that rises in clouds at every step. Claw-furrows score the walls, and
broken stone lies where a great weight has passed. A hot, dry draught
blows down from above, where a ramp climbs to the dragon's lair. A door
west leads back to the skeleton cathedral.

5870.name: The Lair Of The Deadly Black Dragon

down.description: To the down lies Below The Lair Of The Deadly Black Dragon.

5870.description:
A vast cave blackened by dragon fire, its roof lost in smoke and its
floor a sea of soot-grey ash. Charred ribs of earlier victims are heaped
against the walls. A shelf of scorched rock is worn smooth where a huge
body has lain for centuries. The only exit is the door in the floor that
opens down into the chamber below.

5871.name: A Dusty Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Turn In The Dusty Passage.

up.description: To the up lies A Black, Circular Room.

5871.description:
A corridor thick with the dust of centuries, so fine that your steps
raise a pale fog about your knees. Footprints other than yours trace the
floor, some leading nowhere. The dust smells of dry paper and old
incense. A hole in the ceiling opens up to the round room, and the
corridor runs on east to a turn.

5872.name: A Turn In The Dusty Passage

north.description: To the north lies A Bright Copper Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Small, Dust Filled Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Dusty Corridor.

5872.description:
The dusty passage turns here and branches. A faint copper gleam shows to
the north, while to the south the dust lies deeper and a dry rustling
comes from a small chamber. Cobwebs thick as curtains hang across the
passage that leads west. Your hands come away grey from the wall.

5873.name: A Bright Copper Room

north.description: To the north lies A Bright Copper Room.

east.description: To the east lies Before A Small Black Altar.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn In The Dusty Passage.

5873.description:
Every surface in this room is sheathed in beaten copper, polished so
that your light kindles a hundred small suns. A green verdigris creeps
along the seams of the plates. The north side seems to continue but
folds back upon itself, so that walking north returns you here. A door
to the east is plated with copper too, and the passage south goes back
to the dusty turn.

5874.name: Before A Small Black Altar

west.description: To the west lies A Bright Copper Room.

5874.description:
A small altar of black stone stands in the middle of this chamber, its
top stained by old offerings. Candles of black wax have burned to stumps
around it, and the floor is scattered with grains of bitter incense. The
air is thick with a feeling of being watched. The only door leads west
to the copper room.

extra_descs.altar black stone:
The altar is a single block of black stone, its top hollowed into a
shallow bowl. The bowl is stained a deep rust and smells of old iron.

5875.name: A Small, Dust Filled Chamber

north.description: To the north lies A Turn In The Dusty Passage.

south.description: To the south lies A Small, Dust Filled Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hidden Room.

5875.description:
A small chamber so choked with dust that the air itself is grey. Shelves
cut into the walls hold only grey drifts and the outlines of long-gone
jars. To the north the passage returns, and the chamber loops oddly on
itself to the south, leading back to the same dusty floor. In the west
wall a door, nearly hidden by dust, stands in a frame of cracked stone.

5876.name: A Small Hidden Room

east.description: To the east lies A Small, Dust Filled Chamber.

5876.description:
A tiny hidden room, its plaster walls flaking to show the black stone
beneath. The air is still and has the taste of a sealed jar. A narrow
cot of rotted rope and rusted frame stands against one wall, a dead
hermit's last refuge. The only door leads east to the dust-filled
chamber.

5877.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

north.description: To the north lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

up.description: To the up lies The Mist.

5877.description:
You stand among the lowest of the great pillars, each as big around as a
tower and black as a burnt tree. Ropes of mist trail between them. A
stair climbs up into the mist above, and a narrow ledge between the
pillars leads north. The sound of unseen water, far below, rings like a
bell.

5878.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

north.description: To the north lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

south.description: To the south lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5878.description:
A ledge of black stone runs between two pillars, no wider than a cart,
with a long drop on one side. Inscriptions too worn to read run up the
pillars like columns of ants. The mist swirls up out of the void. The
ledge leads north to more pillars, and south to the stair.

5879.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

south.description: To the south lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

west.description: To the west lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5879.description:
The ledge bends around a pillar so thick that it blocks all sight beyond
it. Its base is carved with tiers of grinning faces, each worn smooth by
the wind. The ledge continues west, and south it returns to the pillars
you passed. A cold current slips by, tasting of ash.

5880.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

east.description: To the east lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

west.description: To the west lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5880.description:
A straight stretch of ledge runs between a ring of pillars, the stone
slick and cold. Streamers of black mist wind between the columns, and
voices call from the void. To the east the ledge returns the way you
came, and westward it goes on toward more pillars.

5881.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

east.description: To the east lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

south.description: To the south lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5881.description:
The ledge ends in a small landing at the foot of a pillar split by an
ancient crack wide enough to hide in. From within the crack comes a
faint scratching. The landing opens east back along the way you came,
and southward the ledge starts again.

5882.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

north.description: To the north lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

south.description: To the south lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5882.description:
A long causeway of black stone leads between two lines of pillars like a
processional way, each pillar carved with a hooded figure. The figures'
hands are lifted as though in warning. The mist rolls across the
causeway in slow waves. The way continues north and south.

5883.name: Pillars Of The Abyss

north.description: To the north lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Pillar.

5883.description:
The causeway comes to a rounded landing before a monstrous pillar that
dwarfs all the rest. The mist is thin enough here to show the base of
it, ringed with heavy rusted chains that end in nothing. A short bridge
of black stone leads east to the great pillar, and the causeway runs
back north. The whispers are very close now.

5884.name: A Large Pillar

west.description: To the west lies Pillars Of The Abyss.

5884.description:
A single colossal pillar rises here, wider than a house, carved from its
base to as high as you can see with a spiral of tormented figures. At
its foot is a flat plinth of black stone worn by kneeling knees. Beyond
the edge the mist is a roiling wall. The only way back is west, across
the landing.

extra_descs.pillar figures spiral plinth:
The figures on the pillar writhe upward in a spiral, each reaching for
the one above. At the top of your sight, the largest of them seems to be
reaching down.

5885.name: The Incomplete Pentagram

east.description: To the east lies The Halls Of The Damned.

west.description: To the west lies A Strange Tunnel.

5885.description:
A pentagram is cut into the black floor, but one of its five arms stops
short, the last stroke never finished. The lines glow a dull ember-red
where they were cut deep, and the gap draws the eye and the feet toward
it. Stubs of candles in congealed black wax ring the edge of the room.
The way west returns to the strange tunnel, while an arch east opens on
a darker hall.

extra_descs.pentagram lines arm gap:
Four arms of the pentagram are cut deep and clean. The fifth stops a
hand's breadth short, and the bare stone in the gap is rubbed smooth, as
if many fingers have traced the missing stroke.

5886.name: Under The Well

up.description: To the up lies The Room With No Ceiling.

5886.description:
You stand at the bottom of the well, in a dark chamber floored with silt
and a ring of old stones. Far above, a faint grey glimmer shows the
mouth of the shaft, and a rusted ladder leads up to the room with no
ceiling. Water once filled this place, for the walls are lined with
green slime to the height of a man. The whispers here seem to rise from
beneath the silt.

5887.name: The Halls Of The Damned

west.description: To the west lies The Incomplete Pentagram.

5887.description:
A long hall of black pillars, each carved with the face of one of the
damned, mouths gaping in endless silent screams. Cold seeps up from the
flagstones and the whispering in the gloom is as thick as a crowd.
Rusted chains hang from iron rings set high in the walls, swaying
slightly though no wind stirs. Nothing you can see offers a way onward.

extra_descs.faces pillars damned:
Each pillar is carved with a single face, no two alike. All of them are
mouthing the same word, and the longer you look the more certain you are
that you have heard it.

648800.name: ghost whispering pale
648800.long_desc: A whispering ghost drifts through the mist, its mouth forever shaping a word you cannot catch.
648800.description:
The ghost is a pale, ragged shape of a man who was lost here long ago.
It leans close with a hollow murmur, promising a road out, and its eyes
are black as the stone about you.

648801.name: troglodyte warrior lizard
648801.long_desc: A scaly troglodyte crouches in the dark, a stone-tipped club resting on its shoulder.
648801.description:
The troglodyte is a hunched, grey-green lizard-man with a ridged crest
and flat yellow eyes. A rank musk rolls off it, and its claws click on
the rock.

648802.name: spider crab pale giant
648802.long_desc: A pale crab spider clings to the webbing, its flat body and bristled legs held ready to spring.
648802.description:
The spider is broad and flat like a crab, its shell mottled grey and
bone-white. Eight eyes glitter along its brow, and venom beads at the
tips of its fangs.

648803.name: skeleton bone knight armoured
648803.long_desc: A black-armoured skeleton stands guard in the nave, a rusted blade held in both hands.
648803.description:
A skeleton knight in blackened plate, bones mortared together with clay.
Green fire burns in its empty sockets, and its jaws clatter with the
sound of old prayers.

648804.name: drake black dragon scorched
648804.long_desc: A scorched black drake sprawls in the ash, smoke curling from its nostrils.
648804.description:
The drake is a lesser kin of the dragon whose lair it haunts, smaller
but quick, with scales like wet slate and a hide pitted by old fires.
Its breath is a slow hot haze.

648805.name: ghorak minotaur great
648805.long_desc: Ghorak, the Great Minotaur, stands before his throne of skulls, an axe the size of a door in his fists.
648805.description:
Ghorak is a bull-headed giant, ten feet of knotted muscle with horns
tipped in bronze. Old scars cross his hide, and every breath rumbles
like thunder.

648806.name: vhazul demon abyss abyssal
648806.long_desc: Vhaz'ul, demon of the abyss, rises from the black water, wreathed in mist and cold fire.
648806.description:
Vhaz'ul is tall and winged, with skin the colour of a dead coal and
horns that curl like iron. Where it stands the water of the pool boils
without sound, and its voice is every whisper in the tunnels at once.

748800.name: ring pale whisper
748800.room_desc: A pale ring of bone-white metal lies here.
748800.description: A thin band of pale metal, cold to the touch. If you hold it to your ear it seems to murmur a name that is almost yours.

748801.name: club troglodyte stone
748801.room_desc: A heavy stone-tipped club lies here.
748801.description: A club of knotted wood with a lump of grey stone lashed to the head by sinew. It stinks of musk, but it is well balanced.

748802.name: carapace crab spider vest
748802.room_desc: A pale carapace vest lies here.
748802.description: Plates of spider shell, laced together with silk cord into a light vest. The plates are hard as horn and mottled grey.

748803.name: axe horn minotaur great
748803.room_desc: A huge horn-handled axe lies here.
748803.description: A broad single-bladed axe with a haft cut from a minotaur's horn. The edge is notched but wicked, and the weight sits well in the hands.

748804.name: brand blade abyssal black sword
748804.room_desc: A blade of black glass lies here, trailing a thread of mist.
748804.description: A sword of dark volcanic glass that drinks the light. A faint grey mist clings to the edge, and the hilt hums softly under the palm.
